proof_body:
by
  intro K _inst1 V _inst3 _inst4 _inst5 f hf hs n b a
  exact
    by
      intro he
      apply hf
      apply b.ext
      intro i
      have hz := congrArg (fun q : V →ₗ[K] V => q (b i)) hs
      have heq : (a i * a i) • b i = 0 := by simpa [LinearMap.comp_apply, he, smul_smul] using hz
      have ha : a i = 0 := by
        have hp := (smul_eq_zero.mp heq).resolve_right (b.ne_zero i)
        exact mul_self_eq_zero.mp hp
      simp [he, ha]
target_source: ∀ {K : Type*} [Field K] {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] (f : V →ₗ[K] V) (hf : f ≠ 0) (hs : f.comp f = 0) {n : ℕ} (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) K V) (a : Fin n → K), ¬ (∀ i, f (b i) = a i • b i)
